result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

Both are excellent, but they serve slightly different priorities: 1Password prioritizes ease of use and administration, while Bitwarden offers excellent security and collaboration at a lower price.

## My top 4 picks

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password Business**

(Best overall)

# \$10.99 CAD

Per user/month, annual billing

- Excellent user experience.
- Shared vaults with granular permissions.
- Easy onboarding and offboarding.
- Strong administrative controls.
- Canadian company with Canadian data hosting options.

Website: [1Password Business](https://1password.com/business/)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best value)

# \$4 USD

Per user/month, annual billing

- Open-source password manager.
- Shared collections and organization management.
- Audit logs and directory synchronization.
- Excellent value for growing teams.
- Self-hosting options.

Website: [Bitwarden Business](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper Security**

Best for security-focused businesses

- Strong administrative controls.
- Shared folders and secure file storage.
- Good compliance-oriented features.
- Useful for businesses with stricter security requirements.

Website: [Keeper Business](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

Best privacy-focused alternative

- End-to-end encrypted vaults.
- Secure sharing.
- Email aliases.
- Good option for privacy-conscious teams.

Website: [Proton Pass for Business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

Pricing is indicative and can vary by billing region and plan. Canadian pricing checked against published comparisons from October–November 2026. [www.northvetted.ca](https://www.northvetted.ca/reviews/best-password-manager-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Quick comparison

| Feature | 1Password | Bitwarden |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Ease of use | Excellent | Very good |
| Shared passwords | Yes | Yes |
| Team permissions | Excellent | Very good |
| Admin controls | Excellent | Very good |
| Budget-friendly | Moderate | Excellent |
| Self-hosting | No | Yes |


## What I'd prioritize for a small business

Regardless of which one you choose, make sure it supports\:

1. **Shared company vaults** – Share credentials without sending passwords through email or Slack.
2. **Individual accounts** – Everyone has their own login.
3. **Role-based permissions** – Employees only access the credentials they need.
4. **Easy employee offboarding** – Revoke access immediately when someone leaves.
5. **MFA enforcement** – Require multi-factor authentication.
6. **Audit logs** – Know who accessed or changed shared credentials.

## A couple of questions to narrow it down

I'd like to make a more specific recommendation rather than just give you a generic top-five list.

**1\. How many people are on your team?**

---

**3\. What's most important?**

---

I'll use those answers to recommend one product and the most appropriate subscription tier.
